question.stem:
Find the H.C.F. and L.C.M. of the following expressions:
\(5x^2+20x\)
\(x^2+8x+16\)
question.stemZh:
求以下各式的最大公因式及最小公倍式：
\(5x^2+20x\)
\(x^2+8x+16\)
question.solution:
Factor as \(5x(x+4)\) and \((x+4)^2\), then compare factor powers.
H.C.F.: \(x+4\).
L.C.M.: \(5x(x+4)^2\).
question.solutionZh:
先分解為 \(5x(x+4)\) 及 \((x+4)^2\)，再比較因式次冪。
最大公因式：\(x+4\)。
最小公倍式：\(5x(x+4)^2\)。

question.stem:
Find the H.C.F. and L.C.M. of:

\(u^2-5u-14\)

\(2u^2+11u+14\)
question.stemZh:
求下列各式的最大公因式及最小公倍式：

\(u^2-5u-14\)

\(2u^2+11u+14\)
question.solution:
Factor each expression:

\((u-7)(u+2)\)

\((u+2)(2u+7)\)

For the HCF take the GCD of integer coefficients and minimum common factor powers; for the LCM take their LCM and maximum powers.

\(H=u + 2\).

\[\begin{gathered}L\\=\left(u - 7\right) \left(u + 2\right) \left(2 u + 7\right)\end{gathered}\]
question.solutionZh:
先把各式因式分解：

\((u-7)(u+2)\)

\((u+2)(2u+7)\)

最大公因式取數字係數的最大公因數及共同因式的最低次方；最小公倍式取數字係數的最小公倍數及各因式的最高次方。

\(H=u + 2\)。

\[\begin{gathered}L\\=\left(u - 7\right) \left(u + 2\right) \left(2 u + 7\right)\end{gathered}\]

question.stem:
Find the H.C.F. and L.C.M. of the following expressions:
\(3v^2-9vz-12z^2\)
\(8v^2-36vz+16z^2\)
question.stemZh:
求以下各式的最大公因式及最小公倍式：
\(3v^2-9vz-12z^2\)
\(8v^2-36vz+16z^2\)
question.solution:
Factor as \(3(v-4z)(v+z)\) and \(4(v-4z)(2v-z)\). Only \(v-4z\) is common; the coefficient lcm is 12.
H.C.F.: \(v-4z\).
L.C.M.: \[\begin{gathered}12(v-4z) \cdot(v+z) \\ \cdot(2v-z)\end{gathered}\].
question.solutionZh:
分解為 \(3(v-4z)(v+z)\) 及 \(4(v-4z)(2v-z)\)。只有 \(v-4z\) 共同，係數最小公倍數為 12。
最大公因式：\(v-4z\)。
最小公倍式：\[\begin{gathered}12(v-4z) \cdot(v+z) \\ \cdot(2v-z)\end{gathered}\]。

question.stem:
Find the H.C.F. and L.C.M. of the following expressions:
\(8a^3+1\)
\(2ab+c+b+2ac\)
question.stemZh:
求以下各式的最大公因式及最小公倍式：
\(8a^3+1\)
\(2ab+c+b+2ac\)
question.solution:
Use the sum of cubes and grouping: \((2a+1)(4a^2-2a+1)\) and \((2a+1)(b+c)\).
H.C.F.: \(2a+1\).
L.C.M.: \[\begin{gathered}(2a+1) \cdot(b+c) \\ \cdot(4a^2-2a+1)\end{gathered}\].
question.solutionZh:
利用立方和及分組，得 \((2a+1)(4a^2-2a+1)\) 及 \((2a+1)(b+c)\)。
最大公因式：\(2a+1\)。
最小公倍式：\[\begin{gathered}(2a+1) \cdot(b+c) \\ \cdot(4a^2-2a+1)\end{gathered}\]。

question.solution:
Factor \[\begin{gathered}4x^2+5x+1\\=(4x+1)(x+1)\end{gathered}\] The common-denominator numerator is \(3(x+1)+9x=3(4x+1)\).

Thus the result is \(\frac{3}{x + 1}\).

Keep the original domain: \(x\ne-1,-\frac14\). Cancellation does not restore excluded values.
question.solutionZh:
分母分解為 \[\begin{gathered}4x^2+5x+1\\=(4x+1)(x+1)\end{gathered}\]。通分後分子為 \(3(x+1)+9x=3(4x+1)\)。

所以結果為 \(\frac{3}{x + 1}\)。

保留原式定義域：\(x\ne-1,-\frac14\)。約去因式不能恢復原本排除的值。

question.solution:
The denominators factor as \((x-1)(x^2+x+1)\) and \((x-1)(x-7)\). The combined numerator is \[\begin{gathered}(2x-3)(x-7)\\{}-2(x^2+x+1)\\=-19(x-1)\end{gathered}\]

Thus the result is \(- \frac{19}{\left(x - 7\right) \left(x^{2} + x + 1\right)}\).

Keep the original domain: \(x\ne1,7\) (real variables). Cancellation does not restore excluded values.
question.solutionZh:
分母分別分解為 \((x-1)(x^2+x+1)\) 及 \((x-1)(x-7)\)。通分後分子為 \[\begin{gathered}(2x-3)(x-7)\\{}-2(x^2+x+1)\\=-19(x-1)\end{gathered}\]

所以結果為 \(- \frac{19}{\left(x - 7\right) \left(x^{2} + x + 1\right)}\)。

保留原式定義域：\(x\ne1,7\)（實數變量）。約去因式不能恢復原本排除的值。

question.solution:
Factor \[\begin{gathered}2x^2-13x+6\\=(2x-1)(x-6)\end{gathered}\] \(9-25x^2=(3-5x)(3+5x)\), \(9x^2+6x+1=(3x+1)^2\), \(10x-5=5(2x-1)\) and \[\begin{gathered}3x^2-17x-6\\=(3x+1)(x-6)\end{gathered}\] Cancel common factors in the full product.

Thus the result is \(- \frac{3 x + 1}{5 \left(5 x - 3\right)}\).

Keep the original domain: \[\begin{gathered}x\ne\frac35,\\-\frac35,\frac12,6,\\-\frac13\end{gathered}\] Cancellation does not restore excluded values.

Thus the result is \(0\).
